# UniversityJano.com

> UniversityJano helps Indian students find and join online degree programs without the usual confusion around fees and approvals. The platform lists 25 plus UGC-DEB approved universities offering courses like Online MBA, MCA, BBA, BCA and Data Science. Areas of work: Education & Training, Online Education, EdTech.

- Company type: Private
- Employees: Not Disclosed
- Approx. annual revenue: Not Disclosed
- Products: Online MBA Discovery (Compare UGC-DEB approved online MBA programs); MCA Program Finder (Filter and compare online MCA options); BBA & BCA Explorer (Browse undergraduate online degrees); Data Science Course Hub (Find approved data science programs)
- Services: Free Expert Counselling (One-on-one guidance on university choices); Fee & EMI Verification (Check authentic fees and 0% EMI plans); Placement Record Access (View real placement data from universities)
- Keywords: online mba india, ugc deb universities, online degree comparison, naac grade check, 0 emi online courses, mca online admission, bba distance learning, data science online, placement records universities, free education counselling, online bca india, approved online degrees, university comparison tool
